name: mobius-lattice
prompt: A vast lattice of thin luminous lines that curves back into itself like a Moebius band, seen from inside, so every direction leads back to where it began; one tiny human silhouette stands at the centre looking outward; no horizon, no exit; deep midnight blue with warm gold light; minimalist, elegant, high contrast, book cover artwork, absolutely no text or letters

name: closed-room
prompt: A seamless room whose walls, floor and ceiling are made of fine mathematical grid paper that bends smoothly into one another with no corners and no door; a lone figure stands touching the wall, looking at it closely; soft diffuse light, quiet, painterly, muted ivory and slate grey with one warm accent, book cover artwork, absolutely no text or letters

name: nested-spheres
prompt: A glass sphere containing a smaller glass sphere containing a smaller one, receding inward without end; at the very centre a single human eye is reflected on every surface; dark charcoal background, crisp studio light, minimalist, surreal, book cover artwork, absolutely no text or letters

name: disk-worm
prompt: Macro view of a dark mirror-polished data disk platter; inscribed on it a single glowing spiral trajectory like the path of a small worm, its whole life laid out at once in light; cool blue and amber, abstract, cinematic, book cover artwork, absolutely no text or letters

name: drawing-frame
prompt: A hand drawing the frame of a picture from inside the picture, the drawn frame enclosing the hand that draws it, M. C. Escher inspired lithograph, black ink on cream paper, fine cross-hatching, book cover artwork, absolutely no text or letters
